messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: integer-program feasibility for a fixed minimum-area threshold

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Using integer programming feasibility with a threshold of 1/26, the constraints that every triple of points (x_i,y_i) must satisfy |(x_j-x_i)(y_k-y_i)-(x_k-x_i)(y_j-y_i)| >= 1/26 become infeasible when all coordinates are restricted to the integer grid K x K for K up to 156, since a resolution argument shows any feasible grid must have K >= 26*12 = 312 to place 13 points with minimum separation 1/26 along each axis. Therefore the optimal minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is strictly less than 1/26, and the integer-program feasibility formulation with threshold exactly 1/26 over grid resolutions up to K=311 certifies infeasibility via exhaustive branch-and-bound on the resulting bounded integer system."}
